gen-gf-bellota-gf-monda: Distinctive and a bit swaggering, Bellota draws every stroke like bent wire, with an s whose ends swing far from the spine. Monda is the quieter half, light and open.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-mooli: Plain, unshaded lines with an s that hangs its ends far out: that is Bellota up top. Mooli follows with round, open letters that stay clear even when small.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-murecho: Tubular strokes like bent copper pipe give Bellota its look, with an s whose ends dangle far from the spine. Murecho takes over below with s curves opening wide at both ends, so paragraphs move along cleanly.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-nanum-gothic: Bellota draws every stroke at the width of one stylus, so its line glides under the eye like wire. Nanum Gothic sits beneath it as a sans with wide channels into each counter, keeping things easy to follow.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-national-park: Rounded letters with a clearly open side, drawn by a pen that never shifts pressure or angle, make up the body here. National Park supports Bellota's wire-like display lines by being the plainer, quieter voice.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-niramit: Niramit has curves that look like they are gaping, a body sans-serif that feels professional and clean. Bellota above it, single-weight and outline-like, supplies the character while Niramit does the talking.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-noto-sans-canadian-abo: Distinctive in a quiet way, Bellota hangs the ends of its s far from the spine, with thin joins no slimmer than the stems. And Noto Sans Canadian Aboriginal, a plain sans open at every curve end, feels relaxed beside it.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-noto-sans-cypro-minoan: Bellota keeps bold-looking and light-looking strokes from ever mixing inside a word, and its s ends hang far from the spine. Noto Sans Cypro Minoan cuts its terminals back to leave a big gap, a plain sans that gives Bellota room.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-noto-sans-hanifi-rohin: Bellota is commanding, with horizontals no thinner than its verticals and an s that lets its ends hang away from the spine. Noto Sans Hanifi Rohingya answers with a visibly gaping c at any size, an approachable sans.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-noto-sans-hatran: Noto Sans Hatran is a sans with a wide, funnel-like throat in the e, friendly and plain. Should Bellota's rounded-nib headline be made small, it would lose its commanding pull, while Noto Sans Hatran holds steady.
